title: Key-door maze
summary: Reach the exit under limited energy and time. The key-and-gate route saves energy, direct routes save time, and the exact frontier preserves four tradeoffs that one score would hide.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: The smallest maze with a key, a locked gate, and a real route choice

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: 15 rooms and 25 passages with shared power, protection, persistent injury delays and recovery

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: 24 rooms and 42 passages with more hazards and a second recovery route

strategies.label: Fewest moves
strategies.description: Breadth-first search: the shortest sequence, whatever it costs.

strategies.label: Least energy · uninformed
strategies.description: Dijkstra proves the lowest-energy route without a heuristic.

strategies.label: Least energy
strategies.description: A*, guided by an admissible distance estimate stored in the economy itself.

strategies.label: Pareto: least energy
strategies.description: The lowest-energy point on the exact Pareto frontier, where no route is better on both energy and time.

strategies.label: Pareto: least time
strategies.description: The fastest point on that exact frontier.

title: Sokoban
summary: Push crates onto their goal squares. Every push rewrites three cells at once, and some positions can never be recovered.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: A bounded one-crate teaching puzzle

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Two crates, a pressure plate, a gated chamber, and a remote latch

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Three crates and two coupled door circuits across three chambers

strategies.label: Goal-directed A*
strategies.description: A* prioritises states using an admissible crate-to-goal distance bound.

strategies.label: Fewest exchanges
strategies.description: Breadth-first search explores every shorter replay before accepting a solution.

title: Exact cover
summary: Choose subsets that cover every element exactly once. A plain search and Algorithm X reach the same answer by different routes.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Four elements and four competing subsets

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Eight coupled elements, fourteen irregular subsets, legal dead ends and covers of different sizes

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Twelve globally coupled elements and twenty-five pairs, triples and quadruples

strategies.label: Plain search
strategies.description: Breadth-first search with no knowledge of cover structure; it just tries selections.

strategies.label: Algorithm X
strategies.description: Knuth's Algorithm X chooses the moves; the economy still validates every one.

title: Workshop
summary: Choose funded contracts, prepare components, manage tool wear and deliver products. Exact tradeoffs expose faster work, lower waste and higher revenue.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Two chairs made from raw stock

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Choose two of three chair/table contracts with components, tool wear, repair, upgrades and salvage

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Choose at least three of five contracts under shared wood, time, labor and repair constraints

strategies.label: Fewest steps
strategies.description: Breadth-first search: the fewest recipe firings, whatever they waste.

strategies.label: Least waste
strategies.description: Best-first search guided by scrap accumulated in the workshop account.

strategies.label: Pareto: least waste
strategies.description: The lowest-scrap point on the exact Pareto frontier.

strategies.label: Pareto: least time
strategies.description: The fastest point on that exact frontier.

title: Job-shop scheduling
summary: Route arriving jobs through queues and actual execution. Alternative machines, setup changes, shared crews and a recoverable machine failure change which schedule finishes first.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Two jobs on the smallest horizon that still forces a machine conflict

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Six operations, three alternative machines, two crews and a recoverable disruption at tick three

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: One shared crew, later job arrival and a longer repair create a different execution bottleneck

strategies.label: Shortest makespan
strategies.description: Best-first search on the finish time recorded in the schedule.

strategies.label: Branch optimizer
strategies.description: Depth-first branch-and-bound abandons schedules it can already prove are worse.

strategies.label: Pareto: Job One first
strategies.description: The frontier schedule that finishes Job One earliest.

strategies.label: Pareto: Job Two first
strategies.description: The frontier schedule that finishes Job Two earliest.

title: Uncertain rescue
summary: Search for several hidden casualties while their condition worsens. Trade treatment time, limited medicine, noisy hints and transport fuel against one evacuation seat.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Two possible sites and eight hidden location/sensor outcomes

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Three casualties across four sites, continuing deterioration, two sensor charges, stabilization and finite resupply

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Four casualties across five sites, tighter fuel and crew energy, one evacuation seat and varied deadlines

strategies.label: Observe and triage
strategies.description: Micro evaluates the single search gamble; larger incidents repeatedly scan, search, triage, stabilize and evacuate from public observations.

strategies.label: Rapid sector sweep
strategies.description: Start north without sensing, then revisit search and evacuation decisions as the incident evolves.
strategies.algorithm: Responsive rapid sweep; Micro Monte Carlo

title: Bridge allocation
summary: Timed traffic competes for one occupied lane. Compare fixed priority, urgency-based bids and a paid concurrent detour against arrivals, deadlines and expiring reservations.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: One crossing round for two agents and one lane

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Two traffic waves with staggered arrivals, 2–3 tick crossings, deadlines and a paid detour

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Three traffic waves with persistent credit and changing deadline pressure

strategies.label: Plain search
strategies.description: Breadth-first routing search with immediate ready completions; timed search excludes bidding and deliberate lease expiry.

strategies.label: First come: A
strategies.description: Wait for Agent A, give A first priority, then serve B.

strategies.label: First come: B
strategies.description: Wait for Agent B, give B first priority, then serve A.

strategies.label: Auction
strategies.description: Bids, winner, escrow, refunds, and crossing rights settle through indivisible changes.

strategies.label: Pareto: favors A
strategies.description: Micro: exact frontier. Timed traffic: A's preference among the evaluated routing and auction policies.

strategies.label: Pareto: favors B
strategies.description: Micro: exact frontier. Timed traffic: B's preference among the evaluated routing and auction policies.

title: The Living Market
summary: Watch repeated production and trade reshape a closed economy. Daily needs and obligations, cloudy periods, limited storage, delayed capacity investment, and responsive liquidity interact through an exact constant-product AMM. Missed needs and defaults remain visible.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: A compact closed market that exposes every reserve calculation and refusal

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Eight market days with recurring needs, finite credit, production investment, and responsive trading

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Twelve market days at four times the production scale with the same seeded sunlight across counterfactuals

strategies.label: Responsive market
strategies.description: Actors revisit production, trade, investment, and liquidity decisions throughout the market season.

strategies.label: Counterfactual: no whale
strategies.description: Replay the same economy without its largest buyer and inspect the causal price difference.

strategies.label: Counterfactual: thin liquidity
strategies.description: Withdraw half the founding liquidity and inspect how the same actors adapt to different depth and prices.

title: Lending market
summary: Finance a bill that falls due before revenue arrives. Collateral caps the loan, interest follows pool utilization along a kinked curve, a reserve cut stays with the market, and a scheduled price drop can push an over-borrowed loan into liquidation.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: One pooled market and a two-period gap between the bill and revenue, with a price drop while the loan is open

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: A thin pool near its kink, a bill due early, revenue in two installments and a 40% price drop while the loan is open

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: The Showcase loan at four times the scale over twelve periods, with revenue in three installments

strategies.label: Least interest
strategies.description: Dijkstra search charging each closed period's interest to the plan.

strategies.label: Fewest steps
strategies.description: Breadth-first search: the fewest exchanges, whatever the loan costs.

strategies.label: Over-borrowed
strategies.description: Borrow to the limit at once and watch interest and the price drop end in liquidation.

strategies.label: First-depositor attack
strategies.description: Try to inflate a fresh market's share price against a later depositor.

title: Multi-party marketplace
summary: Negotiate funded contracts, reserve scarce shipping capacity and fulfill deliveries over time. Route delays, price concessions, late rebates and refundable reservations couple buyer and seller outcomes.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Two orders across three buyers, three sellers, and one active carrier

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Four arriving orders with escrow, two occupied carriers, delivery deadlines and price concessions

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Six arriving orders with scarce stock, persistent budgets, route delays and reusable carrier capacity

strategies.label: Clear the market
strategies.description: Pick orders that can all settle together without overdrawing any account.

strategies.label: Pareto: favors buyers
strategies.description: Micro: exact clearing frontier. Larger markets: bounded fulfillment search favoring buyer benefit.

strategies.label: Pareto: favors sellers
strategies.description: Micro: exact clearing frontier. Larger markets: bounded fulfillment search favoring seller benefit.

title: Stochastic logistics
summary: Coordinate refrigerated and heavy-freight vans across three customers. Arriving orders, delivery windows, a shared trunk road, finite fuel, occupied service bays and hub handoffs interact with route disruptions.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Two deliveries with a compact route and a small sample budget

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Two vans, four heterogeneous orders, three customers, one trunk-road slot, two-unit relay hub and finite services

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Six arriving orders, more route delays, a longer horizon, finite fuel and three repair parts

strategies.label: Fastest routes
strategies.description: Use express routes and respond to realized breakdowns; Micro retains sampled single-vehicle evaluation.
strategies.algorithm: Responsive fleet dispatch; Micro Monte Carlo

strategies.label: Reliable routes
strategies.description: Avoid the express link and coordinate deliveries around shared road and service capacity.
strategies.algorithm: Responsive fleet dispatch; Micro Monte Carlo

strategies.label: Relay fleet / Micro MCTS
strategies.description: Larger fleets bundle compatible cargo and hand it off through the hub; Micro retains full receding-horizon Monte Carlo tree search.
strategies.algorithm: Responsive hub relay; Micro Monte Carlo tree search

title: Connect Four
summary: Tactical Connect Four with forced blocks, double threats, positional search, and distinct opponents; gravity and terminal outcomes are core rules.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: A compact board with a short game and few rollouts

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: The full 7×6 board, all 69 lines, tactical self-play and two distinct opponents

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: The full board with four times the MCTS work per move

strategies.label: Tactical MCTS self-play
strategies.description: Both players recognize wins, forced blocks and double threats before exploring positional continuations.

strategies.label: Center-first opponent
strategies.description: Red uses tactical MCTS against a center-first Yellow baseline on the standard board.

strategies.label: Depth-five opponent
strategies.description: Red uses tactical MCTS against depth-five alpha-beta Yellow on the standard board.

title: Autonomous Work League
summary: Four workers share one clock: jobs overlap, repair and charging bays fill, claims expire, and deadlines can be missed. Earned credit funds recovery; recycling restores material; a worker can pay to take over another's contract. Outcomes compare the same job-attempt disruptions across policy fields.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Two agents contest four jobs in a short but complete match

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Four policies contest 12 arriving contracts with deadlines, dependencies, occupied facilities, and paid handoffs

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: 24 contracts over six arrival waves with shared finite supplies and equipment wear

strategies.label: Mixed policy field
strategies.description: A sprinter, steward, value hunter, and resilient worker reveal genuine cross-objective tradeoffs.
strategies.algorithm: deterministic policy league with seeded chance

strategies.label: Throughput field
strategies.description: Most workers prioritize short jobs and fast execution; one still chases contract value.
strategies.algorithm: throughput-biased policy league with seeded chance

strategies.label: Sustainable field
strategies.description: Most workers minimize material loss and recycle, while one specializes in reliability.
strategies.algorithm: resource-biased policy league with seeded chance

title: Hidden-information mission
summary: Coordinate independent Scout and Medic timelines. Share private discoveries, recover archives, stabilize casualties and rendezvous for extraction as hazards close sectors and resources run short.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: Sixteen hidden scenarios with a small per-decision search budget

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: A hidden archive and casualty, independent travel, timed recovery, radio or local briefing, sector hazards and clinical decline

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: A second casualty, one radio charge, lower energy, finite resupply and one evacuation seat

strategies.label: Coordinate independent agents
strategies.description: Larger missions use separate observation-responsive policies with radio briefing; Micro retains belief-conditioned ISMCTS.

strategies.label: Search north first
strategies.description: Larger missions begin north, then coordinate through local briefings. Micro retains the blind joint-movement baseline.
strategies.algorithm: North-first local coordination; Micro Monte Carlo

title: Perishable inventory
summary: Manage scarce refrigerated space, thermal history and daily food obligations. Cooling and processing compete for electricity; backup generation and deliveries compete for fuel.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: One hundred units split between two batches

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Ten crates across six possible cohorts, six days, finite cold storage and a two-day outage

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: Twelve crates, tighter cold storage, less fuel, eight days and a three-day outage

strategies.label: Power outage
strategies.description: Prioritize refrigeration, then revisit shipment, processing and backup decisions each day.

strategies.label: Pareto: save stock
strategies.description: Micro: exact storage frontier. Larger cold chains: a processing-first policy on the same outage schedule.

strategies.label: Pareto: save energy
strategies.description: Micro: minimum-energy storage frontier. Larger cold chains: alternate-day shipping to conserve fuel, with missed demand kept visible.
